name: Peach Mango Sunshine Sorbet
desc: A balanced, creamy Ninja Creami sorbet of peach, mango and banana with no dairy.

source.evidence: Searched Ninja Creami peach mango sorbet recipes (Food Banjo, I Dream of Ice Cream, Detoxinista, Recipes From A Pantry); none use this fruit combination and gram ratio, which reads as the owner's own formula.

ingredients.raw: 200 g ripe mango chunks, fresh or thawed frozen
150 g ripe peaches, pitted and sliced (fresh or thawed frozen)

steps: Blend the mango, peaches, banana, sugar, lemon juice and vodka (if using) until smooth and the sugar has dissolved.
Refrigerate about 30 minutes, then pour into a Ninja Creami pint container, no higher than the max fill line.
Lid the pint and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours, until solid.
Spin on the Sorbet setting. If it is crumbly, add 1-2 tbsp water and Re-spin.

references.title: Ninja Creami Mango Sorbet
references.usedFor: blend then freeze at least 18 hours on a level surface, splash of liquid before a re-spin

references.title: Easy Ninja Creami Mango Sorbet
references.usedFor: max fill line, 24 hour level freeze, Re-spin when crumbly
